subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the
stimulus: sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) Thus he saved his life. (b) He came with a large army. (c) The prince heard the news. (d) Taimur was one of the greatest conquerors of the world. (e) Taimur's soldiers were killed. (f) Taimur disguised himself as a poor traveller. (g) His soldiers surrounded the village on all sides and a terrible battle took place. (h) Once he attacked the province of a powerful prince. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 d h c b g e f a Taimur was one of the greatest conquerors of the world. Once he attacked the province of a powerful prince. The prince heard the news. He came with a large army. His soldiers surrounded the village on all sides and a terrible battle took place. Taimur's soldiers were killed. Taimur disguised himself as a poor traveller. Thus he saved his life. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 168
